03 Project manager, not a sales inbox.
LUPTON ASSOCIATES / Send us the print. / A realistic number in 24 hours. / LUPTONS.COM

voiceover.text: What's the lead time? It's the second question every buyer asks. Price comes first. And that's the wrong order.
I've watched a fourteen-week quote turn into twenty-two. Nobody puts that in the cost comparison.
A late bracket holds up the whole build.
Lead time is honest when the shop runs your part family, an engineer reviewed the print, and you talk to the project manager.
When that's true, the number holds.
Send us the print. You'll have a realistic number in twenty-four hours.
